{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check which rows have missing 'sex' and whether they also have missing 'flipper_length_mm'
missing_sex_rows = df[df['sex'].isnull()]
flipper_values_missing_sex = missing_sex_rows['flipper_length_mm']

# Drop the two rows with missing flipper_length_mm (they are already missing in flipper)
observed_flipper_missing_sex = flipper_values_missing_sex.dropna()

# Compute the mean flipper length for the rows where 'sex' is missing
mean_flipper_missing_sex = observed_flipper_missing_sex.mean()

# Compute the overall mean flipper length (excluding all missing flipper rows)
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
overall_mean_flipper = filtered_df['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Compare the mean flipper length in missing-sex rows to the overall mean
mean_flipper_missing_sex, overall_mean_flipper"}
